richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Pallavaram

c: Pallavaram sits on Chennai's southern edge, close to the airport and the cantonment, where old neighbourhoods now share space with new apartment blocks along GST Road. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Pallavaram for apartment associations, schools, colleges and the corporation's parks. We make every machine at our factory in Vasai, about 1050 km away, and send it to Chennai by road.

Our installers or a dealer in south India then fix the machines on site, following the layout you approved. Chennai's suburbs are hot and humid nearly all year, and the northeast monsoon from October to December can flood low ground quickly. Galvanised frames resist rust in this climate. We suggest a raised base with good drainage, and shade over the machines people use for longest.

items.q: Can outdoor gym equipment be fixed on an apartment podium in Pallavaram?
items.a: Often, yes, using self-standing fixing on a firm slab once your structural engineer approves it. We mark each machine and its clear space on the layout.

items.q: How do we stop flooding around the machines?
items.a: Choose the highest part of the site and build a raised, sloping concrete base. After heavy rain, clear standing water and check the bolts.

items.q: How do I reach FunPlay from Chennai?
items.a: Call +91 902 830 2266 or email sales@funplaysystems.com, Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM. Share photos and site size for a faster reply.
